youtube_description:
₹999 vs ₹1,000: only ₹1 apart, but ₹999 feels WAY cheaper. That's the LEFT-DIGIT EFFECT: your brain reads the first digit and moves on.

Researchers Manoj Thomas and Vicki Morwitz (NYU) showed in the Journal of Consumer Research (2005) that nine-ending prices feel lower, especially when the leftmost digit changes.

Rule: round UP in your head (₹999 = ₹1,000, ₹1,999 = ₹2,000), then decide.

Source: Thomas & Morwitz, 'Penny Wise and Pound Foolish: The Left-Digit Effect in Price Cognition', Journal of Consumer Research, 2005.
